A bipedal bear divided vertically into two contrasting halves. The right side is snowy white with a soft texture, while the left side is charcoal black with a jagged, sinister expression. The right eye is a neutral circle and the left eye is a glowing red spiral. The body is plump and pear-shaped with small paws featuring three claws each. The tail is short and stubby, split between white and black.
BODY COLOR: black and white
